matches.description: Matches kept, not counting deleted ones; matches recorded on a watch are never refused. Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

referees.description: Referees kept. Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

venues.description: Venues kept. Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

storageMb.description: Megabytes of photos and tracks (SEC-6); a track recorded on a watch is never refused. Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

photoMb.description: The largest photo, in megabytes; the server's own most, 10 MB, still applies. Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

fileMb.description: The largest file brought in (an import or a restore), in megabytes; the server's own most for each (5 MB and 2 GB) still applies. Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

devices.description: Watches and phones signed in at once (PLAN-7); browsers don't count. Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

pushPerDay.description: Phone notifications a day (from midnight UTC), across all the account's phones (PLAN-8). Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

apiKeys.description: API keys (KEY-1). Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

apiCallsPerMinute.description: Requests made with the account's API keys a minute, all its keys together (PLAN-8). Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

apiCallsPerDay.description: Requests made with the account's API keys a day (from midnight UTC), all its keys together (PLAN-8). Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

webhooks.description: Webhooks (HOOK-1). Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

assignorCalendars.description: Assignor calendars (FEED-10). Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.

addressSearchesPerDay.description: Address searches a day (from midnight UTC), for placing venues on the map (PLAN-11). Left out: no limit; 0: none at all.
